description:
Send the agent a message about a document (POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/messages). Paid by actual usage.

request.text is a change request ("add a section on risks", "make the totals formulas") or a question. The agent
decides from the text: it either answers and updates the summary without rebuilding the file, or rebuilds the
document when asked; result.version grows only when the file changed, last_agent_message holds the answer.
Optional file_urls (up to 5 public HTTPS links or urls from upload_media, same formats and limits as
create_document) add new material to the running session. Answers 202 at once; follow it with get_document until
awaiting_input. It is refused with 409 while the agent is still working and for a failed or archived document,
and with 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE when the balance is below the minimum (see estimate_document).
name: revise_document
